description: This file defines the 'Attribute' interface for the OpenMRS core project, representing a generic user-defined attribute linked to various entities. It includes method signatures for getting and setting the owner, as well as retrieving the attribute type.

methods.name: getOwner
methods.description: Returns the owner object that this attribute belongs to.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the owner object for this attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeType
methods.description: Returns the AttributeType associated with this attribute.
